The service bay gains authored construction detail, but the approach remains a broad empty road with repeated facades and primitive interior structure; dense vertical industrial layers are absent.

Steel/paint/rubber separation is visible on the service bay, but coarse mottling, whole-panel orange damage feedback and a primitive colored switch interface remain. The switch is now supported by the correctly placed cabinet. Road and surrounding structures lack convincing wet wear, reflected light and material detail.
No visible organic infection invades engineered structures. Red actor colors do not satisfy this requirement.
Two motivated warm task lamps now illuminate the panels, but clear daylight and exposed sky still lack the required cold storm atmosphere and coherent scene-wide lighting contrast.
